name: AstroCore Mining
detailed_description:
Astrocore Mining is a colony simulation sandbox game set in the unforgiving depths of space. Manage a mining colony on asteroids, extract valuable resources, and meet corporate quotas, or face dire consequences. Layout Planning is key; design and build underground bases, optimize resource management, and maintain a balance between survival and efficiency. Command ships, defend against pirate raids, and modify asteroids with thrusters to advance to the next system. Can you survive the harsh demands of deep-space capitalism?

The game is under development. Visuals does not represent end-quality of the game.

Build, Expand, and Exploit

  • Asteroid Colonization: Transform lifeless rock into a thriving mining operation. Tunnel through asteroids, construct underground facilities, and optimize your colony’s layout for efficiency.

  • Dynamic Resource System: Extract rare minerals, refine resources, and maintain a steady supply chain to meet corporate demands.

  • Survival & Population Management: Keep your colonists alive in the cold void of space. Oxygen, food, power, and morale; every detail matters in maintaining a stable workforce.

  • Procedural Asteroid Generation: Each system presents new challenges with unique asteroid compositions and environmental hazards.

The game is under development. Visuals does not represent end-quality of the game.

Space is Not Empty. It's Dangerous.

  • Hostile Encounters: Defend your operation against pirate raids, corporate rivals, and the unpredictable dangers of deep space.

  • Attack Ships and Defense: Deploy defenses to protect your assets or raid enemies with attack ships for valuable loot.

  • Asteroid Modification: There's no end to expansion. Attach thrusters to asteroids and guide them to new star systems for fresh mining opportunities.

The game is under development. Visuals does not represent end-quality of the game.

Total Control, Real Consequences

  • Layout Planning & Automation: Give direct orders to colonists, manage work schedules, and let AI-driven decisions shape the fate of your workforce.

  • Corporate Quotas & Survival Strategy: The company demands results. If you fail to meet expectations, your career and your life are over.

  • Morality vs. Efficiency: Will you care for your workers, or push them to the brink for maximum productivity? The fate of your colony rests in your hands.

Are You Ready to Survive the Final Frontier?

Astrocore Mining challenges you to master the brutal balance between survival, strategy, and sacrifice. Expand your empire, optimize resource management, push your workforce to the edge, and decide how far you'll go to ensure profit... because in space, nobody cares if you scream.

Wishlist now and prepare for launch!

short_description: Welcome to Astrocore Mining! The Harsh Reality of Space Capitalism. Profit is everything, and you’re expendable. Extract resources, meet quotas, and survive; whatever it takes. But beware: failure isn’t just a setback, it’s a death sentence. How far will you go in this brutal frontier?
